description: Sheri Biggs – a lieutenant colonel in the Air National Guard, a board certified family nurse practitioner, and board certified psychiatric mental health nurse practitioner, Salem resident, and a pro-life, pro-Second Amendment lifelong Republican – announced she is running to serve South Carolina’s Third Congressional District.
